decisionsTitle: «Lista internă de așteptare»: people kept in mind for an event, told nothing, moved to the official list by hand
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-26:** «Aș vrea să pot pune manual oameni pe lista de așteptare, dar fără să le zic sau să le trimit vreun email» — then, asked whether that meant the real queue: a list internal to the organizers, not a registration; «după vreau să-i pot pune și pe lista oficială, practic ei au cerut prin formularul de contact»; and «e important să putem lăsa note interne pentru participanți».

**Decision.** A new table, `event_reserve_entries`, one row per person per event: first name, last name, the address they wrote from (optional), one internal note, who wrote it down and when. It is shown as the panel «Lista internă de așteptare» on one event's registrations list, to the Organizer and above (`canKeepRegistrationNotes`, the internal notes' own rule, §777), asserted in `reserve-list.ts` (BR-REQ-060-01). Verbs: «Adaugă», «Salvează nota» (an empty box clears it), «Șterge», and «Trece pe lista oficială».

**It is not a registration and not the waiting list.** No participant, no place, no slot in the queue, no state, no email, no count the club or the public is given; the allocator and the capacity formula never read the table, so `AGENTS.md` §10.6 and the staff verbs of §15.11 are untouched. Putting the person in the real queue silently was refused: a queued row is offered a freed place by email (automatically or by «Trimite-i oferta»), and a row in the queue without the person's own confirmed address and declaration is exactly the staff power CLAUDE.md's table says does not exist.

**«Trece pe lista oficială»** opens the ordinary staff entry (`/admin/registrations/new`, BR-REQ-037-05) prefilled with the line's event, name and address and the line's id. From there it is a registration like any other — the same allocator, the back of the queue when the event is full, the relay box ticked by the person who presses (they did ask, through the contact form), and the person's own email with the link. After the entry is written, `settleReserveEntry` carries the line's note onto the new registration as an internal note (§777) and removes the line, audited `event_reserve.moved`; a registration of another event (the event changed on the form, or a forged id) gets nothing and the line stays. A line whose event takes no entries now opens the form unfilled, with a warning. `createRegistrationByStaff` now returns the id of the row it wrote.

**Personal data.** The trail (`event_reserve.added`, `note_saved`, `deleted`, `moved`, entity `event`) names who, when and the line's id — never a name, an address or the note's words. The lines go with their event (`ON DELETE CASCADE`); there is no separate retention sweep. Whether the privacy notice must name this list (people who wrote to the club, kept for an event they asked about) is the owner's and the lawyer's question, not decided here; the contact form's own paragraph is where it would go.
changelogLine: - **«Lista internă de așteptare» on an event's registrations list** — the organizers write down people who asked for a place (say through the contact form), with an internal note; nobody is registered, counted or emailed, until «Trece pe lista oficială» opens the ordinary staff entry prefilled and the note follows the registration. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a person written on an event's internal waiting list, when an Organizer or above adds, edits or deletes the line, then no registration, participant or email exists for them and the allocator counts nothing; when «Trece pe lista oficială» enters them through the ordinary staff entry, the line's note becomes the new registration's internal note and the line is removed — never onto a registration of another event (2026-10-26, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: an internal waiting list per event, told nothing, moved to the official list by hand
